Design:

User Story

As a system User
I want to be able to preview customer details page
So that I can get all the information about customer from one interface

Acceptance Criteria

  1. Check system user permissions to open customer detail’s page 

    1. Viewing Customers

      1. Allows to see all customers in system

    2. Viewing Customers (with GDPR masking)

      1. Allows to see all customers in system, but in some fields ‘GDPR’ label is displayed instead of real customer GDPR masking fields:

    3. Viewing Customers with the user entered as an Account manager

      1. Allows to see only customers to which he/she is an account manager 

    4. Viewing Customers with the user entered as an Account manager (with GDPR masking)

      1. Allows to see only customers to which he/she is an account manager, but in some fields ‘GDPR’ label is displayed instead of real customer data GDPR masking fields:

    5. Viewing deleted Customers

      1. Allows to see all deleted customers in system; 

        1. Edit/Delete buttons are disabled, read only view will be loaded

    6. When the resigning date comes, the system should mark the contract, the customer in this contract and the PODs (active) of the contract as ready for re-signing. (2)

      1. Marker should appear on specific contract version

      2. Marker should appear on specific customer version

      3. Marker should appear on POD object

      4. Markers should appear separately for objects (separate for contract version, separate for customer version, separate for POD), on preview and edit mode

      5. Marker should appear on the customer exact version that is in contract which is available for re-signing and

      6. Marker should say: “ready for re-signing”  - “ÐÐ¾ÑÐ¾Ð² Ð·Ð° Ð¿ÑÐµÐ¿Ð¾Ð´Ð¿Ð¸ÑÐ²Ð°Ð½Ðµ”

      7. If customer is at least in one contract which is ready for re-signing, than marker should appear

      8. If POD is at least in one contract which is ready for re-signing, than marker should appear

      9. Contracts that can be available for re-signing should have following statuses

        • Active in term

        • Active in perpetuity (always available for re-signing)

      10. The system should calculate the date based on the terms field “deadline for early re-signing” and contract term end date

        1. If period is > (contract term end date – deadline for early re-signing) and < contract term end date, then contract is available for re-signing

          1. For active in term contracts:

            1. If the “deadline for early re-signing” is not filled, the contract will always be ready for re-signing

            2. If the “Contract term end date” is not filled, the contract should not be marked as available for re-signing

              1. Examples for active in term contracts:

                1. deadline for early re-signing is filled, contract term end date is empty - never available for re-signing.

                2. deadline for early re-signing is filled, contract term end date is filled - calculate the ready-for-re-signing period.

                3. deadline for early re-signing is empty, contract term end date is empty - never available for re-signing.

                4. deadline for early re-signing is empty, contract term end date is filled - always available for re-signing.

          2. For active in perpetuity contracts:

            1. If the contract is Active in perpetuity, it is always available for re-signing

      11. The markers on all objects should disappear when:

        1. All PODs in Contract are marked as “re-signed”

        2. Specific time window has passed

        3. Contract status is changed to terminated or cancelled

      12. Available period for re-signing should be recalculated if:

        1. Contract term end date is changed

        2. Deadline for early re-signing is changed

        3. If necessary, markers should disappear and then appear when the relevant date comes

      13. If a POD is marked as re-signed, it can not be ready for re-signing.

      14. If all PODs in the contract are already marked as re-signed, the contract cannot be marked as "Ready for Re-signing”

     

    1. Create Task from Customer

      1. Allows to add Task in the Customer in the preview mode

      2. This permission grants the ability to create tasks in the Preview.

        1. In the preview/edit mode, the Task button should be enabled.

        2. If the user does not have customer edit permission, it is only possible to create a task in the Preview.

        3. It is not possible to add a task in the deleted Customer Preview mode

  2. Tasks displaying logic / format:

    1. In the task sub-object, a maximum of 10 tasks should be displayed on one pagination page.

    2. Pagination should be visible always

    https://www.figma.com/design/rdEFquUpErpUGFXdQt7vmV/Energo-Pro?node-id=65-10578&p=f&t=KyHodtuLD672pbRa-0

    1. Task list logic:

      1. The tasks ordering should be descending by time creation

      2. Also the task format should be changed, we need to have the next format:

        1. Id

          1. Take from task number field - This logic is already added

        2. Display task status

          1. Task status should be taken from task object

          2. In the system we have the next task statuses:

            1. Open

            2. In Progress

            3. Terminated

            4. Overdue

            5. Completed

        3. Date in format DD.MM.YYYY

          1. This logic is already added.

        4. Task type

          1. Task type should be taken from task type dropdown - this logic is already added

        5. Example:

          1. 841 - in progress – 26.02.2025 - YOLS-TEST(1)

  3. Page title

    1. The page title on Customer Preview displays customer name and customer number after the word “Customer” (EN) or “ÐÐ»Ð¸ÐµÐ½Ñ” (BG).

    2. EN format: Customer

    3. BG format: ÐÐ»Ð¸ÐµÐ½Ñ

    4. For Legal entities, is Name + Legal form separated by a space.

    5. For Private customers, is Name + Middle name + Surname separated by a space; if Middle name is NULL, omit it (do not leave an extra space).

    6. When UI language is English, use the main Name field values; do not switch to transliterated names.

  4. Last customer’s version will be loaded on customer detail page by default considering permissions

  5. From Version’s dropdown will be possible to change version and display different version of customer 

  6. In versions dropdown should display:

    1. version number

    2. version creation date

    3. E.g. 1 8/15.04.2021

  7. All Fields will be disabled in customer detail page /in Pop-ups

  8. Edit/Remove icons will be displayed for editing/removing customer

  9. Buttons/icons are hidden:

    1. ‘Save existing version’ button in Footer

    2. ‘Create new version’ button in Footer

    3. ‘Plus’ buttons on right panel

    4. ‘Delete’ icons next to each sub-object record will be removed

    5. ‘Ok’ green button will be removed on pop-ups

GDPR masking fields: 

  1. Personal Number / Personal Number of a foreigner for Managers

  2. Personal Number / Personal Number of a foreigner for Private customer

  3. Name for Private customer

  4. Name (Transliteration) for Private customer

  5. Middle Name for Private customer

  6. Middle Name (Transliteration) for Private customer

  7. Surname for Private customer

  8. Surname (Transliteration) for Private customer

  9. Personal Number / Personal Number of a foreigner for Private customer with business activity

  10. Name for Private customer with business activity

  11. Name (Transliteration) for Private customer with business activity

  12. Middle Name for Private customer with business activity

  13. Middle Name (Transliteration) for Private customer with business activity

  14. Surname for Private customer with business activity

  15. Surname (Transliteration) for Private customer with business activity

  16. Date of birth for Managers

 

GDPR - Sub-objects:

  1. Managers

    1. personal number - GDPR

    2. date of birth - - GDPR

    3. (name, middle name and surname are displayed and no need to hide them )

  2. Related customer

    1. Personal number - GDPR

    2. Name, middle name, surname - GDPR

  3. Owners

    1. Personal number - GDPR

    2. Name, middle name, surname - GDPR

    3.  (for owners with legal type we do not hide UIC and name of a company)

  4. Communication data ->contact person

    1. Date of birth of contact person - GDPR

    2. Name, middle name, surname - GDPR

  5. Account managers

    1. GDPR doesn't needed
